title: Pattern work at a non-towered field

briefing.description: A calm morning at Cedar Valley, a quiet non-towered field. You'll fly one lap in the traffic pattern: taxi out, depart, fly the pattern, land, and taxi back — self-announcing every leg on CTAF. Winds favor runway {rwy}. Remember the CTAF formula: who you're talking to, who you are, where you are / what you're doing, and the airport name again at the end.

steps.prompt: You're at the ramp, engine running, ready to taxi to runway {rwy}. Announce your taxi on CTAF.
steps.hint: Cedar Valley traffic, Skyhawk {callsign}, taxiing from the ramp to runway {rwy}, Cedar Valley.

elements.label: addressing “Cedar Valley traffic”
elements.feedbackMissing: Start with who you're addressing: “Cedar Valley traffic” tells everyone on the shared frequency which airport this is about.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: You never said who you are — include your callsign, e.g. “Skyhawk {callsign}”.

elements.label: taxi intention
elements.feedbackMissing: Say what you're doing: “taxiing to runway {rwy}”.

elements.label: the runway
elements.feedbackMissing: Name the runway you're taxiing to so pattern traffic knows which end to watch.
elements.feedbackWrong: You said runway {heard}, but you're taxiing to runway {rwy}.

elements.label: closing with the airport name
elements.feedbackMissing: Pros close CTAF calls by repeating the airport name — pilots tuning in mid-call still learn where you are.

steps.text: Run-up complete. You're holding short of runway {rwy}, and final is clear.

steps.prompt: Announce your departure before taking the runway. You're staying in the pattern.
steps.hint: Cedar Valley traffic, Skyhawk {callsign}, departing runway {rwy}, remaining in the pattern, Cedar Valley.

elements.label: addressing “Cedar Valley traffic”
elements.feedbackMissing: Start with “Cedar Valley traffic” so everyone knows which airport you're departing.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign so traffic can track who's where.

elements.label: departure announcement
elements.feedbackMissing: Say you're “departing runway {rwy}” — that's the key information for anyone on final.

elements.label: the runway
elements.feedbackMissing: Name the departure runway.
elements.feedbackWrong: You said runway {heard}, but you're departing runway {rwy}.

elements.label: staying in the pattern
elements.feedbackMissing: Say your intentions after departure — “remaining in the pattern” tells others you'll be right back on downwind.

elements.label: closing with the airport name
elements.feedbackMissing: Close with the airport name: “…Cedar Valley.”

steps.text: You lift off and climb upwind. Passing 700 feet AGL, you start your crosswind turn.

steps.hint: Cedar Valley traffic, Skyhawk {callsign}, left crosswind runway {rwy}, Cedar Valley.

elements.label: addressing “Cedar Valley traffic”
elements.feedbackMissing: Lead with “Cedar Valley traffic”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign.

elements.label: position report (crosswind)
elements.feedbackMissing: Report the pattern leg you're on: “left crosswind runway {rwy}”.

elements.label: the runway
elements.feedbackMissing: Include the runway in position calls — “crosswind runway {rwy}”.
elements.feedbackWrong: You said runway {heard}, but the pattern is for runway {rwy}.

steps.text: You level off at pattern altitude and turn downwind, running your before-landing checks.

steps.hint: Cedar Valley traffic, Skyhawk {callsign}, left downwind runway {rwy}, Cedar Valley.

elements.label: addressing “Cedar Valley traffic”
elements.feedbackMissing: Lead with “Cedar Valley traffic”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign.

elements.label: position report (downwind)
elements.feedbackMissing: Report your pattern leg: “left downwind runway {rwy}”.

elements.label: the runway
elements.feedbackMissing: Include the runway in position calls.
elements.feedbackWrong: You said runway {heard}, but the pattern is for runway {rwy}.

steps.text: Abeam the numbers, power back, flaps set. You turn base.

steps.hint: Cedar Valley traffic, Skyhawk {callsign}, left base runway {rwy}, Cedar Valley.

elements.label: addressing “Cedar Valley traffic”
elements.feedbackMissing: Lead with “Cedar Valley traffic”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign.

elements.label: position report (base)
elements.feedbackMissing: Report your pattern leg: “left base runway {rwy}”.

elements.label: the runway
elements.feedbackMissing: Include the runway in position calls.
elements.feedbackWrong: You said runway {heard}, but the pattern is for runway {rwy}.

steps.text: You roll out on final, lined up with runway {rwy}. This will be a full stop.

steps.prompt: Announce final, and include your intentions (full stop).
steps.hint: Cedar Valley traffic, Skyhawk {callsign}, final runway {rwy}, full stop, Cedar Valley.

elements.label: addressing “Cedar Valley traffic”
elements.feedbackMissing: Lead with “Cedar Valley traffic”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign.

elements.label: position report (final)
elements.feedbackMissing: Report that you're on final — anyone holding short needs to hear it.

elements.label: the runway
elements.feedbackMissing: Include the runway.
elements.feedbackWrong: You said runway {heard}, but you're landing on runway {rwy}.

elements.label: landing intentions
elements.feedbackMissing: Saying “full stop” (vs “touch and go”) helps traffic plan their spacing behind you.

steps.text: Nice landing. You slow down and exit onto the taxiway, clear of runway {rwy}.

steps.prompt: Let everyone know you're clear of the runway.
steps.hint: Cedar Valley traffic, Skyhawk {callsign}, clear of runway {rwy}, taxiing to the ramp, Cedar Valley.

elements.label: addressing “Cedar Valley traffic”
elements.feedbackMissing: Lead with “Cedar Valley traffic”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign.

elements.label: clear-of-runway report
elements.feedbackMissing: Announce “clear of runway {rwy}” — the aircraft on final is waiting to hear exactly this.

elements.label: the runway
elements.feedbackMissing: Include the runway you just cleared.
elements.feedbackWrong: You said runway {heard}, but you landed on runway {rwy}.
